_meta.description: Synthetic quarterly financial data designed to trip exactly 3 of 5 quality flags: receivables_growing_faster (YES), inventory (NO), dso (YES), ocf_vs_netincome (YES), sbc (NO).

flag_reasoning.receivables_growing_faster_than_revenue: Receivables grew ~56% QoQ (from 160M to 250M over 3 quarters) vs revenue ~11%. Ratio triggers at >2x revenue growth rate.
flag_reasoning.inventory_buildup: Inventory growth 6.7% vs revenue 11% — within threshold, no flag.
flag_reasoning.dso_expanding: DSO: (250/1000)*90=22.5 days current vs (160/900)*90=16 days one year ago. Expansion >4 days triggers flag.
flag_reasoning.ocf_vs_net_income: OCF 100M vs Net Income 150M = 67% conversion. Below 80% threshold triggers yellow (below 60% would be red).
flag_reasoning.sbc_as_pct_revenue: SBC 20M / Revenue 1000M = 2% — below 10% threshold, no flag.
